India's Services Exports and PE/VC Investments Show Growth in July

India's services exports increased by 13.4% to reach USD 38.25 billion in July, according to the Reserve Bank of India. Concurrently, private equity and venture capital investments in India saw a significant rise of 52%, totaling $4.1 billion for the month of July. These figures indicate positive momentum in key sectors of the Indian economy.
